title: Explore an imperative API for setting a tldraw license
reason: Proposes an imperative license API as an alternative to passing a license through the React tree, in the context of whether licensing checks belong on individual components. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's licensing/runtime initialization contract was not inspected; no SDK compatibility change is inferred.

title: Increase test coverage for the editor package
reason: Documents upstream editor line/branch/function coverage and proposes targeted coverage improvements with an explicit focus on testing behavioral seams. The sole comment reinforces seam coverage; no Varve coverage gap is identified.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a repository-specific coverage plan, not evidence to broaden Varve's test suite beyond affected behavior.

title: Comments: pressing Delete with a comment pin selected should delete the comment
reason: Reports Delete/Backspace doing nothing for a selected hosted collaboration comment pin. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no comment-pin feature to reproduce this hosted collaboration behavior.

title: Comments: Edited label overlaps the edit button
reason: Reports an overlap between an edited comment label and its edit control. The issue includes a screenshot but no reproduction steps or comments; the image was not independently inspected.

varveAssessment.assessment: The affected comments UI does not exist in Varve, and no visual analogy was claimed.

title: Comments: Tab after selecting a comment pin doesn't move focus to the reply input
reason: Reports focus order stopping at a hosted comment pin rather than continuing to its thread reply input. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: There is no Varve comment-thread reply control corresponding to the reported focus path.

title: Comments: allow comments to be attached to groups
reason: Requests anchoring hosted comments to groups and lists unresolved questions about group versus member anchoring and what happens after ungrouping. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no multiplayer comments feature; this is not a group-selection defect in the editor.

title: Comments: zooming to a comment doesn't account for the comments sidebar
reason: Reports comment navigation centering under the open thread sidebar instead of within the remaining visible canvas. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The behavior depends on an upstream comments sidebar and navigation command that Varve does not provide.

title: Comments: Frames are missing a hover state
reason: Reports no visual feedback when hovering a frame, while noting interior hover intentionally targets content rather than the frame. The triage notes identify heading/label hover styling as the likely surface; no discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential frame affordance lead, but Varve frame hover behavior was not inspected or visually reproduced.

title: Comments: rotating a shape doesn't move its comment pin to the correct position
reason: Reports hosted comment pins failing to transform with a rotated shape and proposes storing a shape-relative point. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no comment-pin anchors; no transform defect can be inferred from this upstream feature.

title: Comments: comment pins aren't stable when a shape is rotated
reason: Reports instability of shape-attached comment pins during rotation, with the exact failure mode still uncertain. Retain separately from #9718 while linking the related transform concern.

varveAssessment.assessment: This depends on hosted comment-anchor behavior absent from Varve.
